attributes.name: Hrym
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d8+1; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d8 plus the scenario's adventure deck number and the Cold trait, then ignore any monster's power that happens after you act.

On your Diplomacy check, reveal this card to treat your Diplomacy skill as d10+3.

At the start of your turn, reveal this card to recharge the ally Rodrick from your discard pile.
